alternatives_named: Defer M-CC fold until all M-CC IPs are complete (avoid renaming in-progress work)
Use M00 as a new milestone for M-CC content instead of folding into M01

rejected_reasons: Deferring violates user directive 'in the end no M-CC' and leaves M-CC strings as long-lived debt. Fold-now is cheaper than fold-later.

M00 keeps the milestone count high (M00..M07) and introduces yet another short-lived milestone. M01-foundation already covers 'foundation' semantically; the user-explicit choice in the AskUserQuestion was 'Fold M-CC phases into M01-foundation'.

Multi-PR split would require an intermediate state where some phases are renamed and others are not — masterplan.json + every cross-ref would temporarily diverge. Atomic mega-PR avoids the intermediate-broken-state class of bugs. Review cost is high but reversibility is single-commit.
